scope: Independent post-selection magnetic-operator audit over the declared processing domain, no route outputs or production data
timing: Declared after fresh generation started, before examining fresh generated code or check outcomes. Cases follow the already fixed physical grid, not model benefit.
selection_effect: None. Keep first original-verifier pass frozen; an additional-domain failure makes its recommendation unusable, and never feeds repair or reselection.
beta_rule: MaterialParams(c0=.5,T_s=933).beta_M while field on; zero while off
h_rule: beta/2 for 1 T with Js_a=2 T; zero while off
field_rule: Two smooth deterministic fields spanning approximately .1 to .9, differing by spatial phase; independent five finite-difference directions per case
checker: Unchanged magnetic_task.check/energy finite-difference verifier, injected case fixture; original 1e-4 relative derivative threshold. Record finite-difference halving changes and all failures.
additional_check_cost: Charge observed executions and seconds separately from generation-visible verification; deduplicate identical frozen source but retain reuse attribution.
